tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: A trend which is common to elements of both the group 1<sup>st</sup> and group 17<sup>th</sup>, on going from top to bottom

solution.text: A trend which is common to elements of both the group 1<sup>st</sup> and group 17<sup>th</sup>, on going from top to bottom is that the ionization energy decreases since the atomic size increases.
